scenes.vo: Lesson fourteen point zero. Mastery Starter.

scenes.sub: At mastery, you watch everything automatically and act through rules and limited permissions, never by handing over keys. Then you prove it with the operator capstone.

scenes.title: Words you'll need
scenes.vo: Alert, an automatic notification tied to an action. Keeper, an automated service that executes conditions. Session key, a limited, revocable permission. Change control, a written, delayed process for new risks. R.P.C., a connection that lets software read the chain.
scenes.cap: Alert, an automatic notification tied to an action Keeper, an automated service that executes conditions Session key, a limited, revocable permission Change control, a written, delayed process for new risks RPC, a connection that lets software read the chain

scenes.sub: Set one alert today: a health factor, a peg or any outflow from your vault wallet.

scenes.title: The mastery ladder
scenes.vo: Beginner, Has alerts mapped to actions. Practitioner, Automates one task with scoped permissions and writes signing procedures. Master, Builds read-only tools and passes the operator capstone.
